# Crypto AI Advisor — Pipeline Requirements (HTML Format) ```html Crypto AI Advisor - Pipeline Requirements

Crypto AI Advisor — Multi-Model Pipeline Requirements

Objective: Build an efficient multi-layer crypto signal pipeline that minimizes API usage while maximizing high-quality trade opportunities using shared market data, multiple analysis models, and a final confluence validation layer.

1. System Architecture Overview

Layer Description
Layer 1 Shared market data fetch from CoinGecko API.
Layer 2 Shared pre-filter to remove low-quality coins.
Layer 3 Model-specific filtering and heavy analysis.
Layer 4 Watchlist generation and logging.
Layer 5 Final confluence validation before entry recommendation.
Entry Layer Trader confirmation panel with manual execution.

2. Shared Data Fetch Requirements

2.1 Data Source

  • Use CoinGecko Top 300 market API.
  • Fetch market cap, volume, and 24h change data.
  • Single API request shared across all models.

2.2 Cache Strategy

  • Cache duration: 5 minutes.
  • All downstream models must reuse cached data.
  • Prevent duplicated API calls across models.

2.3 Required Fields

  • Coin symbol
  • Coin ID
  • Market cap
  • 24h trading volume
  • 24h price change percentage
  • Rank
  • Current price

3. Shared Pre-Filter Requirements

3.1 Filtering Objective

Reduce total candidate coins from approximately 300 coins into 150–200 valid trading candidates.

3.2 Remove Criteria

  • Stablecoins
  • Wrapped tokens
  • Coins with volume below $1M
  • Coins with market cap below $50M
  • Coins with incomplete or null data

3.3 Expected Output

  • Filtered shared dataset accessible by all models.
  • Dataset must be cached and reusable.

4. Model Requirements

4.1 Model 1 — Counter Trend

Target Coins Rank 50–300 with volume above $5M
Strategy Type Counter-trend reversal detection
Heavy Analysis
  • OHLCV 15m and 4H
  • Open Interest (OI)
  • CVD analysis
  • Liquidity sweep detection
  • Market structure shift (MSS)

4.2 Model 2 — Pre-Pump Detection

Target Coins Rank 20–150 with volume above $10M
Strategy Type Early accumulation and breakout preparation
Heavy Analysis
  • Funding rate
  • Open Interest (OI)
  • ATR analysis
  • CVD compression
  • OHLCV 4H

4.3 Model 3 — Trend Momentum

Target Coins Rank 1–50 with volume above $50M
Strategy Type Strong trend continuation momentum
Heavy Analysis
  • EMA 50/200
  • MACD
  • RSI
  • Break of structure (BOS)
  • OHLCV 1D and 4H

4.4 Model 4 — Spot Gainers

Target Coins Rank 1–200 with top 24h gainers
Strategy Type Spot trading momentum continuation
Heavy Analysis
  • OHLCV 1D
  • Candle pattern criteria
  • Volume spike validation
  • Stop loss calculation

5. OHLCV Shared Cache Requirements

  • All OHLCV data must use centralized caching.
  • Cache key format: symbol_interval.
  • Identical coin/timeframe requests must not trigger repeated fetches.
  • Shared across all analysis models.

6. Watchlist Requirements

6.1 Watchlist Generation

  • Each model generates Top 10 candidates.
  • Automatically logged into database.

6.2 Watchlist Monitoring

  • Periodic logging every 4 hours.
  • Track OI changes.
  • Track funding rate changes.
  • Track CVD changes.

6.3 Persistence

  • Coins failing final validation remain inside watchlist.
  • Historical signal tracking must be retained.

7. Final Confluence Filter Requirements

7.1 Validation Objective

Ensure only high-confidence signals reach trader confirmation stage.

7.2 Mandatory Conditions

  • All required signals must pass simultaneously.
  • Stop loss distance must be valid.
  • Raw leverage score must exceed 10x equivalent confidence threshold.
  • Skip rule must not be triggered.

7.3 System Actions

  • Store final result in database.
  • Trigger notification system.
  • Send candidate to trader UI.

8. Entry Confirmation Panel Requirements

8.1 UI Information

  • Entry price
  • Stop loss level
  • Target T1, T2, and T3
  • Recommended leverage
  • Recommended position size ($5–$10)

8.2 Execution Flow

  • Trader executes manually at exchange.
  • No auto-trading during early phase implementation.

8.3 Data Retention

  • All entries saved into database.
  • Data reusable for backtesting.
  • Data reusable for forward testing.
  • Data reusable for AI optimization training.

9. Performance and Optimization Requirements

Requirement Target
Daily API usage 5,000–8,000 calls/day
Optimization target Reduce approximately 95% API usage compared to naive approach
Pipeline architecture Shared cache and layered filtering mandatory
System design Asynchronous and scalable

10. Future Expansion Requirements

  • AI scoring optimization layer
  • Adaptive filtering thresholds
  • Automated backtesting engine
  • Forward testing analytics
  • Telegram and mobile push notifications
  • Multi-exchange support
  • Risk management automation
Initial implementation priority should focus on data efficiency, watchlist quality, and consistent signal generation before introducing automated execution.
```
